name: gaming-pc-thermal-and-cooling-benchmarks
description: A collection of measurements and test cases that evaluate thermal behavior and cooling solutions for gaming PC components and configurations. The benchmark captures temperature profiles, fan curves, and performance under varied workloads to enable prediction and comparison of cooling effectiveness. It is intended to support models that predict thermal outcomes or recommend cooling configurations from hardware and workload parameters.
evaluation_method: RMSE/MAE (for prediction) and accuracy/F1 (for classification tasks)
reputation: A niche, specialized dataset primarily used by hardware enthusiasts and researchers; limited mainstream adoption.
